title: finality
description: Reproducible research code for banking-sector cyber risk: a rational-choice model of attacker venue selection with an exact finality decomposition, a loss-distribution Monte Carlo with a planted Pareto tail, peaks-over-threshold GPD inference with delta-method, parametric-bootstrap and profile-likelihood intervals, a Monte Carlo audit of their coverage for extreme return levels, and a linear DebtRank model of interbank contagion with its spectral phase transition. Companion software to the preprint "False Confidence in the Tail: Finality, Extreme-Value Uncertainty, and Contagion in Banking-Sector Cyber Risk". All parameters are illustrative.
